comparison.objective: Install a reducing sleeve before placing a conical tube in an oversized heat-block well versus commission a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Ordered sleeve and tube insertion/alignment versus setscrew tooling, fine collar rotation, locking, and repeated impact assessment.
comparison.success_condition: Sleeve precedes and supports the tube; fit/depth thresholds are missing. Candidate requires quantitative safe-cycle behavior and drift resistance.
comparison.reason: Adapter-mediated insertion is a different tested ability.
